commits.message: Show scores as a dot strip per campaign
commits.body:
The scores section was a wrap of uneven chips, each carrying a level
name and a best-score phrase, up to twenty of them. It is now one row
of numbered dots per campaign: outlined until cleared, filled once
cleared, gold when cleared in a single launch. The per-level best count
already appears on the game screen's result card, so the sheet no
longer repeats it, and the two strings it used are gone.

commits.message: Simplify the info sheet
commits.body:

only for tube and hole kinds present on this rotor, and the maths

commits.message: v1.1.0: lab campaign, licence, English, shorter text
commits.body:
Lab mode: ten new levels where specimen tubes are fixed and the player
balances the rotor with a limited budget of water-filled spare tubes,
the way a bench technologist does. Each budget equals the brute-forced
minimum and that minimum has a single solution (checked by a test), so
the limit is the puzzle. Lab progress and best scores are stored apart
from the classic campaign.

Licence: clearing all ten classic levels awards a Medical Technologist
Licence with confetti, an issue date, a licence number, score stats
and an optional nickname kept on the device. It is reachable from a
header badge and can be shared as an image through the system share
sheet (share_plus; no new permissions). Clearing the lab campaign adds
a Lab Endorsed stamp.

Localization: gen-l10n with Traditional Chinese and English ARB
files; English is the fallback for non-Chinese systems. Game state
now emits message ids rather than strings. On-screen copy is cut
back: level title plus a spare-tube chip, no standing explanations,
shorter hints, icons for first-try and continue.

Also: privacy policy mentions the local nickname and the share sheet
(in-app and privacy.html, both languages), README and store release
notes updated, version 1.1.0+2.

commits.body:
主委要求：①加公告章、管委會字樣 ②圓圈不填色。

- 圓圈改「白底＋車種色外框」：不填色（省墨、可書寫），以外框色保留大／小位區分；
  編號改黑字（白字在空心圓上看不見）。不用全透明，因底圖線條會穿過編號（實測
  1、4、5 號的三角形與無障礙位輪椅圖示）。公益／鎖定外圈外推，與車種框分開。
  --filled 可切回舊實心樣式。

- extract-seals.mjs：從公告 PDF 剪下兩顆章並去背（連通區塊濾除掃描灰塵）。

⚠️ repo 公開：印章圖檔一律放 private/seals/（不進版控）；電子章版若輸出到 public/
   直接拋錯——public/ 隨網站部署，任何人都能下載印章偽造公告。防呆以絕對路徑比對，

docs: 每日工作紀錄 2026-10-11 (2 commits)
修正每日備份半路無聲中斷：寫 log 改用 .NET AppendAllText
commits.body:
10/6、10/9、10/10、10/11 的 DB 備份都在 log 寫了 start 之後就沒下文。
原因是這台的 Add-Content 連續寫入時約九成會丟「Stream was not readable」
（推測是防毒即時掃描剛寫完的檔），在 ErrorActionPreference=Stop 下
整支腳本直接中斷，連錯誤都來不及記。

- backup-db.ps1：Log 與 db-counts.json 改用 [IO.File]::AppendAllText / WriteAllText
- sync-content.ps1：同步紀錄改成一次 AppendAllText（原本逐行 Add-Content，有檔案異動時最容易中斷）

實測 Add-Content 60 次失敗 56 次、AppendAllText 60 次 0 失敗；手動完整跑兩支皆 exit 0。
